title: Five Nights at Freakboys
description:
This mod is a fan project inspired by "Five Nights at F*boy’s" (Joshua Shaw) and "Five Nights at Freddy's World" (Scott Cawthon). All assets are custom-made for this mod. No copyright infringement intended.

This mod add content from FNaFb, FNaF World.
body:
This mod adds content from FNaFb, FNaF World and FNaF series in general.

This mod adds:
1. New biomes; tiled fazbear biome and Fazbear Hills
2. 3 variations of party hat mob
3. Enragement Child as a boss.
4. Adventure animatronics that can join your party
5. Swag animatronics that can join your party
6. New armour 
7. New items

Mobs and especially new Boss are very hard and I recommend to deal with them at late-game.

                        How to make animatronics join your party?
To make the adventure animatronics join your party you should try giving them party hats (some animatronics require better party hats than others) and after a few tries they should join your party!

To make the swags join your party you shoul make swag remnant out of "Sorry, Im SWAG" helmet. Then try to give remnant to the swag and after a few tries they should join your party!


If you are a fan of FNaFb or FNaF franchise you should check this mod out! Have a good game!
This mod is in beta, so expect bugs and lack of content.
